title: Building the Next Issue
excerpt: A look at the editorial rhythm for upcoming Barrog issues and how contributors can follow along.
author: ella
body: The next issue is taking shape through essays, images, interviews, and shorter fragments gathered across the month.
As pieces move through editing and design, we will use this page for practical updates: deadlines, launch notes, contributor announcements, and small reflections from the process.
If you are following Barrog from the outside, this blog should feel like a window into the magazine as it is being made.
